name: js-ts-exactness-unresolved
body: The JS/TS unification must preserve the never-guess rule: an edge is emitted only where the checker resolves to a project symbol. Dynamic JavaScript — untyped params, computed access, monkey-patching, dynamic require(expr) — yields an UnresolvedTarget (with a category), never a fabricated FQN. A higher unresolved ratio than typed TS is expected and acceptable. AC: a dynamic-require fixture produces only unresolved_call/unresolved_use edges and no guessed calls/uses edge.
